note: Provenance for the screenshots in this directory. These are not redistributable third-party marks like the agent icons — they are screen captures of macOS system UI, made on a Mac running OneAgent, showing what the operating system displays when it blocks an unsigned application. Apple owns the interface elements pictured. They are included because the Gatekeeper guide cannot be followed without seeing which dialog is which, and a described-only version would send readers hunting through System Settings. No Apple endorsement is implied. Captured with no account name, device name, or other identifying detail visible; verified before committing.
